title: Construction of Government IT Park Building

demo_extraction.scope_summary: Construct a seven-storey IT park building including civil, electrical and HVAC works. Provide raised flooring and server room civil works. Complete construction within 24 months.

eligibility.requirement: Valid NTN and active ATL status
eligibility.source_quote: The bidder must hold a valid National Tax Number (NTN) and appear on the FBR Active Taxpayers List (ATL).
The contractor must hold a valid Pakistan Engineering Council (PEC) registration in category C-3 or above for civil works.

eligibility.requirement: Minimum annual turnover of PKR 300 million in the last financial year.
eligibility.source_quote: Minimum annual turnover of PKR 300 million in the last financial year.
Affidavit on stamp paper that the bidder has not been blacklisted by any government body.
Bid security in the form of a pay order or bank guarantee shall accompany the financial bid.
